sections.text: مقدمة

This document 
 outlines the major maintenance procedures P1, which must be performed every 
 16000 operating hours as indicated by H16000 in the title block.

The axial fans 
 are used for forwarding the cooling air required for the generator they force 
 the cooling air to form a steady circulation within the machine.

There are two 
 axial fans for every generator. They are mounted on the rotor shaft next to 
 the rotor end bells the blades are mounted in diametrically opposed 
 positions.

This document 
 initiated by eng. Ayman Mohamed Mohamed, tested by eng. Magdi Sami Ebrahim and 
 eng. Mohamed Elsayed Ahmed, approved by eng.Mohamed Salah Eldin Abd Elghafar 
 general director.

This document 
 revised by eng. Nageh Soliman Shousha: CEPC quality control director, and 
 certified by eng. Afaf Ebrahim El-Dib: CEPC inspection & quality control's 
 Head Sector and MPIS coordinator

الاحتياطات

A 
work permit must be issued and the qualified 
maintenance staff should carry the suitable safety category.

Safety fence with 
caution marks surrounding the work area.

Wear safety helmet, shoes, breathing-mask, 
safety glasses is required.
The gas turbine out of service.
The generator on a complete isolation.

sections.text: Assembly and installation

The axial fan 
blades must not be mounted in place until after turbo rotor has been put in. 
observes the following points in mounting:

Keep the same numbering. Due to 
 imbalance, it is not permissible to exchange the axial fan blades one for 
 other.

اضبط شفرة المروحة المحورية بهذه الطريقة 
 تعمل هذه القاعدة بالتوازي مع وضع العلامات (انظر ورقة الفحص).

Grease the thread and the nut 
 support surface of the axial fan blade 1ightky with molykote, and tighten the 
 nut to approx. one third of the required torque. See axial fan data.

Make definitive tightening of the 
 nut all at once using a torque wrench 901.

Secure the threaded pin in place 
 by punching.
